_note: Registry seed. Free-first providers are included alongside optional paid providers. Google Search grounding is used for real-time web research when the selected Gemini model/account supports it. Local image generation is enabled when LOCAL_IMAGE_API_URL is configured.

tools.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
tools.summary: General reasoning, coding and long-context work with Gemini.

tools.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
tools.summary: Fast, low-cost Gemini model for light reasoning, documents and checks.

tools.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite + Google Search
tools.summary: Web research using Gemini with Google Search grounding and returned source citations.

tools.name: Groq GPT-OSS 120B
tools.summary: Very fast alternative reasoning and coding model through Groq.

tools.name: Hugging Face GPT-OSS 120B
tools.summary: Open-model alternative through Hugging Face Inference Providers.

tools.name: Gemini image generation
tools.summary: Generates images with Google Gemini using your saved Gemini key. No extra provider needed.

tools.name: Free image generation (Pollinations)
tools.summary: Free image generation, no key needed. Backup when Gemini's image quota runs out. Prompts go to pollinations.ai.

tools.name: Local Stable Diffusion
tools.summary: Generates images locally through an Automatic1111/Forge-compatible open-source image server. No cloud key.

tools.name: Claude Opus 5.5
tools.summary: Optional paid provider for deepest reasoning and careful review.

tools.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
tools.summary: Optional paid provider for balanced writing, code and long documents.

tools.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
tools.summary: Optional paid provider for fast light reasoning, file handling and checks.

tools.name: Brave Search
tools.summary: Optional paid web search provider with current web results and sources.

tools.name: OpenAI image generation
tools.summary: Optional paid cloud image generation provider.

tools.name: Python sandbox
tools.summary: Runs code in an isolated environment. Built in, no key needed.
